title: ArtifactRef
description: A pointer to stored bytes. Deliberately not a URL and not a credential: resolving a reference is a service boundary's job, and a signed link placed here would outlive the authorization that made it.

ref.description: An opaque storage reference the Control Plane can resolve.

contentType.description: An IANA media type, without parameters.

byteSize.description: Size of the stored bytes. The ceiling is an explicit conservative one; no existing limit governs artifacts yet.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes.
